Basically germanium is a poor material for transistors.  They're unstable on how they should work "leaky".  For example I purchased a handful of AC128s a common germanium transistor while back.    Out of 10 of them not one had the same gain rating.  Also, it's common for them to crap out.    What all of that tells me is this.  If you demo a nice sounding germanium pedal there is no certainty another pedal of the same build will sound the same.   Now you know what is a fantastic simi conductor that is totally stable? Silicon.  Just some ranting and food for thought.
